articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Persistent Memory and Extended Reasoning Chains
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in late June 2026, featuring native long-term memory across sessions and significantly improved multi-step reasoning. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level math and science benchmarks, and introduces a new "deep research" mode capable of autonomously conducting multi-hour investigations with cited sources. Enterprise API pricing follows a new tiered compute model based on reasoning depth.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves New State-of-the-Art on Multimodal Agent Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on agentic task benchmarks including OSWorld and WebArena, demonstrating near-human performance in executing complex multi-step workflows across desktop and web environments. The model features a 2-million-token native context window and improved grounding capabilities that significantly reduce hallucination rates in long-context retrieval tasks.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered volume deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant, handling parts kitting, quality inspection, and light assembly tasks across multiple production lines. The robots operate alongside human workers with a reported 97.5% task completion rate and leverage onboard vision-language models for zero-shot adaptation to new part configurations.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Chaining in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid performing a continuous 45-minute sequence of household chores including laundry folding, dishwasher loading, and floor cleaning without human intervention. The demo highlighted a new hierarchical task planner built on an in-house vision-language-action model trained on millions of hours of teleoperation data. Tesla reiterated plans for limited consumer availability in early 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's 'Artifact Workspaces' for Collaborative AI-Assisted Software Engineering
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a new collaborative development environment where Claude can maintain persistent project state, run code in sandboxed containers, and iteratively build full-stack applications alongside engineering teams. The feature integrates directly with GitHub and supports real-time pair programming with branching conversation threads. Early benchmarks show a 40% reduction in time-to-prototype for internal pilot teams.

articles.title: ASML Reports Breakthrough in High-NA EUV Yield, Clearing Path to Sub-1nm Chip Production
articles.summary: ASML disclosed that its high-NA EUV lithography systems have achieved production-grade wafer yields exceeding 90% at Intel and TSMC fabs, a milestone that had been delayed by stochastic defect challenges. This advancement clears a critical bottleneck for the A14 and N2P process nodes targeting sub-1nm equivalent transistor densities expected in 2027 chip designs, with implications for next-generation AI accelerator performance.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA approval for its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and introduces bidirectional stimulation capabilities. The expanded trial will include patients with spinal cord injuries, with preliminary data from the first cohort showing participants able to control robotic arms with sufficient dexterity to perform daily living tasks. The approval marks a significant regulatory milestone for invasive BCI technology.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Electric for Hazardous Industrial Inspection
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial version of its electric Atlas humanoid robot, purpose-built for inspection and light manipulation in oil and gas, chemical, and nuclear facilities. The robot features IP67 ingress protection, ATEX Zone 1 hazardous environment certification, and an autonomous navigation stack that integrates real-time 3D SLAM with a foundation model for anomaly detection in infrastructure scans.
